sloka: ब्राह्मेणास्त्रेण सम्योज्य ब्रह्मदण्डनिभम् शरम् ।सम्योज्य धनुषि श्रे ष्ठे विचकर्ष महाबलः ॥६-२२-५॥।।
transliteration: brāhmeṇāstreṇa samyojya brahmadaṇḍanibham śaram ।samyojya dhanuṣi śre ṣṭhe vicakarṣa mahābalaḥ ॥6-22-5॥।।

translations.english: Rama proceeded to stretch the mighty bow that resembled the rod of punishment of Brahma energized by Brahma and released that best of bows.
